Oh god. |audio = ContainmentWave26-1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 26 ([[Containment]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Withered''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had high health, fast speed and 50% defense. It also had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The '''Withered''' was an entity with most of its dark grey skeleton exposed. It had dark grey claws on its hands and feet, torso with fur around its neck and a grey skull with neon orange eyes and antlers. It also had two additional arms on its back. When it was killed, it fell over causing its head to fall off. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]], can be quite effective against this. *While it is quite fast, it has multiple immunities that make it harder to slow down. More specifically, it is immune to being knocked back, frozen, chilled and is only slowed down by stuns. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be used to drop its defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **Freeze defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png|'''Withered''' on the game thumbnail.
